newsitem.title: USA: American Eagle Group says changes on board.
newsitem.headline: American Eagle Group says changes on board.

text.p: American Eagle Group Inc said Wednesday that four board members resigned their positions ahead of a previously scheduled July 31 streamlining of the insurance company's management structure.

The company said in a statement that Joseph Grant, Keith Hughes, James Maser and Elvis Mason have resigned as directors of the company. In addition, Frederick G. Anderson, senior vice president, general counsel and secretary has resigned effective July 31, 1997, and the position of general counsel will be eliminated.
